tests.name: constructor stores three distinct owners and a fixed threshold of two
constructor rejects a zero owner
constructor rejects duplicate owners
any supporter can deposit ETH and the receipt emits the correct balance
submission records exact payment fields and does not implicitly approve
a non-owner cannot submit a request
a non-owner cannot confirm a request
a non-owner cannot revoke another owner approval
a non-owner cannot execute an otherwise approved payment
submission rejects the zero recipient
submission rejects a zero amount
submission rejects an empty description commitment
nonexistent request identifiers are rejected by reads and all actions
one owner cannot count a duplicate approval twice
zero approvals cannot release funds
one approval cannot release funds even in a mined transaction
two distinct approvals allow exactly the requested ETH transfer
the third owner can execute a payment approved by the other two
revocation removes authority until a second distinct approval is restored
an owner cannot revoke an approval they did not give
insufficient balance rejects execution and a later deposit permits retry
an executed request cannot pay twice
executed requests reject further confirmations and revocations
a reverting receiver rolls back execution and can be paid after recovery
an owner-recipient cannot reenter the same request
an owner-recipient cannot reenter a different approved request
approval count matches the set of owners across revoke and reconfirm sequences
competing approved requests cannot spend more than the current treasury balance
canonical lifecycle records actual gas used by mined transactions

limitations: Local EVM tests only; no public-network deployment established.
Not a formal verification or independent security audit.
